sentences.text:
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE RAKESH KUMAR  CRIMINAL PETITION No.7761 of 2019 ORDER:
-
Heard Sri A.Pandu Ranga Rao, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the State.

Invoking inherent jurisdiction of this Court, this Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
praying for quashing out entire proceedings in C.C.No.72 of 2018 pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur, registered for the offences under Sections 273 and 188 I.P.C. and Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It was argued that in identical situation, number of proceedings have been quashed by this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has specifically placed an order kept at page No.22 passed in Crl.P.No.4978 of 2019 on 12.09.2019.

By the said order, this Court quashed the proceedings initiated under the same provision under Sections 273, 188 IPC and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, on the ground that any sale or purchase of tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act.
In the present case also, it was alleged that the petitioner was indulged in sale of tobacco and gutka etc.

Considering the fact that in identical situation, proceedings have been quashed and the present case is also squarely covered by order dated 12.09.2019 in Crl.P.No.4978 of 2019, there is no reason to pass a different order.
In view of the settled principle, the proceedings in C.C.No.72 of 2018 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE RAKESH KUMAR Date: 20.12.2019 Pab V Jayaprakash vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 20 December, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49258983/
